sentences.en: On June 4, 1924, a girl was admitted to the Virginia State Colony for epileptics and feeble-minded.
sentences.zh: 1924年6月4日，一名女孩被送入弗吉尼亚州立癫痫与智力低下者收容所。

sentences.en: She was white, dark-haired, and 17 years old.

sentences.zh: 她成为了该收容所的第1692号院民。

sentences.en: The medical superintendent of the colony examined her.
sentences.zh: 收容所的医疗主管对她进行了检查。

sentences.en: He declared her healthy, free of syphilis, able to read, write, and keep herself tidy.
sentences.zh: 他宣布她身体健康，没有梅毒，识字，会写字，也能保持个人整洁。

sentences.en: And then he classified her as feeble-minded of the lowest grade, moron class.
sentences.zh: 然后，他把她归类为最低等级的智力低下者，也就是白痴级别。

sentences.en: With that designation, this young woman, who'd already lost more than many people could bear in a lifetime,
sentences.zh: 带着这个定性，这个年轻的女性——她已经承受了许多人一生中难以承受的苦难——

sentences.en: was set on a path she didn't choose.
sentences.zh: 踏上了一条并非她所选择的道路。

sentences.en: What happened next laid the foundation for one of the most tragic social experiments in American history,
sentences.zh: 接下来发生的事情，为美国历史上最悲惨的一场社会实验奠定了基础，

sentences.en: the forced sterilization of tens of thousands of people.
sentences.zh: 即对数万人实施强制绝育。

sentences.en: This story has resonance even today.
sentences.zh: 这个故事在今天依然有着共鸣。

sentences.en: It's about how science and the law, tools that we have created to help improve our lives,
sentences.zh: 它讲述了科学与法律——我们为了改善生活而创造的工具——

sentences.en: can easily become instruments of prejudice and oppression.
sentences.zh: 如何轻易地变成偏见与压迫的工具。

sentences.en: It's a story of hubris and about good intentions gone awry.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于傲慢以及好心办坏事的故事。

sentences.en: Eugenics and the science of better breeding, this week on Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 优生学与改良繁育科学，本周《隐藏的大脑》为您播出。

sentences.en: First of all, please tell me your name.
sentences.zh: 首先，请告诉我你的名字。

sentences.en: In 1980, an NPR reporter, Wendy Blair, took a trip to a one-room shack outside Charlottesville, Virginia.
sentences.zh: 1980年，NPR记者温迪·布莱尔前往弗吉尼亚州夏洛茨维尔市外的一间单间小屋。

sentences.en: She'd come to interview a 78-year-old woman.
sentences.zh: 她来采访一位78岁的老妇人。

sentences.en: Her married name was Dedimore, but her given name was Carrie Buck.
sentences.zh: 她婚后的姓氏是德迪莫尔，但她的本名是卡丽·巴克。

sentences.en: You see, I was adopted when I was a little girl.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我还是小女孩的时候就被收养了。

sentences.en: I was adopted by the Dobbs this year in Charlottesville.
sentences.zh: 我今年在夏洛茨维尔被多布斯夫妇收养了。

sentences.en: This interview was one of the few that Carrie Buck ever gave.
sentences.zh: 这次采访是卡丽·巴克接受过的极少数采访之一。

sentences.en: By this point, she had little to say.
sentences.zh: 到了这个时候，她已经无话可说了。

sentences.en: It was left to others to reconstruct her story.
sentences.zh: 重构她故事的任务只能留给其他人。

sentences.en: One of those who took up the task was historian and lawyer Paul Lombardo.
sentences.zh: 承担这项任务的人之一是历史学家兼律师保罗·伦巴多。

sentences.en: He's the author of the book, Three Generations, No Imbeciles, Eugenics, The Supreme Court, and Buck v.
sentences.zh: 他是《三代人，没有笨蛋：优生学、最高法院与巴克诉贝尔案》一书的作者。

sentences.en: Paul says the story of Carrie Buck really begins in the 19th century.
sentences.zh: 保罗说，卡丽·巴克的故事其实始于19世纪。

sentences.en: Francis Galton was a cousin of Charles Darwin who came up with the theory of evolution.
sentences.zh: 弗朗西斯·高尔顿是查尔斯·达尔文的表弟，他提出了进化论。

sentences.en: Francis Galton was interested in evolution, but he was more interested in what he saw as the applications of this science.
sentences.zh: 弗朗西斯·高尔顿对进化感兴趣，但他更感兴趣的是他所看到的这门科学的应用。

sentences.en: His passion, really, his driving force was to measure things and try to calculate how the future was going to play out in human behavior.
sentences.zh: 他的热情，或者说他的驱动力，是去衡量事物，并试图计算人类行为的未来将如何发展。

sentences.en: I think the thing we know him for the most now are his coinage of the term eugenics,
sentences.zh: 我想我们现在最熟知他的，是他创造了“优生学”这个词，

sentences.en: but also his real foundation of what we think of as modern statistical theory.
sentences.zh: 但他也真正奠定了我们现在所理解的现代统计学理论。

sentences.en: When Galton introduced the idea of eugenics, what was his thinking?
sentences.zh: 当高尔顿引入优生学的概念时，他的想法是什么？

sentences.en: What was he aiming to do?
Well, as I said, he was looking a great deal at patterns of behavior and trying to figure out why it was that genius,
sentences.zh: 嗯，正如我所说，他大量研究了行为模式，并试图弄清楚为什么天才——

sentences.en: the ability to think productively, and other abilities, how these clustered in families.
sentences.zh: 进行富有成效的思考的能力以及其他能力——这些能力是如何在家族中聚集的。

sentences.en: And so we see him very early in his career suggesting that maybe there's a way of understanding this clustering of ability
sentences.zh: 所以在他的职业生涯早期，我们就看到他提出，也许有一种方法可以理解这种能力的聚集，

sentences.en: and, for that matter, disability in certain families, there must be something that is biological about it,
sentences.zh: 以及某些家族中能力的缺失，这里面一定有什么生物学层面的东西，

sentences.en: something that's inherent to the organism.
sentences.zh: 某种有机体固有的东西。

sentences.en: And he proposes that this thing is really something you can think of as eugenics,
sentences.zh: 他提出，这个东西其实可以被视为优生学，

sentences.en: which is a way of organizing people that will encourage the people who are prosperous and who are healthy and who are productive
sentences.zh: 这是一种组织人们的方式，它将鼓励那些繁荣、健康、富有成效的人

sentences.en: to marry other people of similar talents and then pass on their abilities to children
sentences.zh: 与拥有类似才能的人结婚，从而将他们的能力传给孩子，

sentences.en: and, at the same time, discourage people who are not successful and not productive, perhaps are poor, perhaps unwell,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，不鼓励那些不成功、没有生产力、可能贫穷、可能身体不适的人繁衍，

sentences.en: and over time, the negative ones will fall out of the population.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，不良基因就会从人口中消失。

sentences.en: To be fair, lots of people pair up with others who are similar in education and social class.
sentences.zh: 平心而论，很多人都会与教育和社会阶层相似的人结为伴侣。

sentences.en: But Francis Galton, writing in the early 20th century, wanted the state to get involved.
sentences.zh: 但生活在20世纪初的弗朗西斯·高尔顿，希望国家介入进来。

sentences.en: I cannot doubt that our democracy will ultimately refuse consent to that liberty of propagating children

sentences.en: But the populace has yet to be taught the true state of things.

sentences.en: A democracy cannot endure unless it be composed of able citizens.

sentences.en: Therefore, it must, in self-defense, withstand the free introduction of degenerate stock.

sentences.en: These ideas coincided with a new movement in the United States.
